title: ר' פנחס החבר
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness
attribution: Fresh project English, authored from the frozen Hebrew and revised through source-informed author and independent model review. Editorial-layer attribution in the Warsaw witness remains qualified.

paragraphs: R' Pinhas the haver, in R' Yonah's name. I have not found him mentioned. Perhaps he is the aforementioned Pinhas of Havrah who was appointed High Priest. But the statement ‘in R' Yonah's name’ makes no sense [Heilprin’s objection; Shemot Rabbah 1:14 attests this wording].
